title: Companions have no visible HP, wound state, or 'downed' condition anywhere in the UI (not in combat logs, not in status). Across roughly a dozen fights spanning the whole run, only the player character's hp ever changes; companions only ever land hits or miss, never take or show damage, and the promised 'who gets hit, who goes down, whether they get back up' dynamic never has any mechanical hook to observe. Companion jeopardy in this run only ever manifested through dialogue/approval consequences (Lys leaving), never through combat.
where: all combat encounters / status command — companion HP is absent
